site.title: SUPERHERO · MoonWitness / Rocksoul Research
site.description: SUPERHERO — provenance-first actor and transmission intelligence for MoonWitness / Rocksoul Research.

hero.headline: TRACE THE PERSON.
hero.copy: Actor & transmission intelligence for reconstructing identity, witnessing, authorship, recording, interpretation, and narrative chain of custody without turning attribution into verdict.

sections.label: People
sections.headline: FIND THE ACTOR. INSPECT THE ATTRIBUTION.
sections.description: Canonical and candidate PERSON records remain distinct, searchable, and fully inspectable.

sections.label: Transmission
sections.headline: FOLLOW THE HUMAN CHAIN.
sections.description: Every actor relationship exposes role, temporal proximity, confidence, supporting references, and uncertainty.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.headline: ATTRIBUTION NEEDS SUPPORT.
sections.description: Claims and evidence remain separate records; stance, confidence, limitations and sources stay visible.

sections.label: Sources
sections.headline: OPEN THE RECORD.
sections.description: Local source records expose complete provenance, creator, date, locator, quality, notes and citation context.

sections.label: Uncertainty
sections.headline: GAPS ARE DATA.
sections.description: Identity, witnessing, authorship and transmission can be strong in one dimension and unresolved in another.

sections.label: Taxonomy
sections.headline: NAME THE EDGE.
sections.description: Relation types and proximity states come from the canonical taxonomy rather than UI literals.

sections.label: Contract
sections.headline: SHOW THE SCHEMA.
sections.description: Every record type exposes its machine-readable schema and field contract alongside the records it governs.
